status: Prospective local specification after inspecting source schema and three example rows, before v1.3 policy outcomes; not external preregistration. All additions follow earlier v1.2 results.
pool_selection: Fixed model identities from archive metadata, not chosen by measured accuracy; slots deliberately span provider families. Not chronological within-agent checkpoints.
split: SHA256 of normalized question (MMLU question+choices), salt dtmoa-proeval-v13, thresholds 0.6/0.8. Exact groups cannot cross train/dev/test, including across pools.
policy_class: Conditional empirical answer-agreement partition; selection among acquired answers or defer. Prompt baselines alone additionally use hashed character TF-IDF query features and ridge error prediction; report this information difference. No free-text synthesis.
cumulative_score_scope: Mechanism-inspired, NOT a CERA-MoA reproduction: no hidden-state backbone, anchor loss, DAPO/GSPO, LoRA or agent training. NOT a Jev reproduction.
refresh: Deterministic non-test calibration prefix; four archived responses per refreshed question; full-information feedback, not bandit-selected feedback. Refresh queries charged and deployment break-even reported, no target-test feedback.
inference: Paired group bootstrap within each binary dataset, macro average; 2000 draws fixed seed 130918. Intervals conditional on fitted policies; no equivalence claim when zero included. No p-values promised.
quality: Primary binary loss is archived error label, never used as observation. Strict response-only normalization vs archive gold is a separate post-selection audit, not retuning. DICES archived ordinal error reported separately, no probability-of-correctness or ECE claim.
calibration: Brier score and ten equal-width-bin ECE on answered binary cases only; independent gold calibration added as secondary audit. No Jev-calibration claim.
cost_scope: Uniform assumed price per archived answer, not actual dollars, token counts or inference latency. Control CPU benchmark separate; no artificial LLM latency.
limits: One archive is not five independent data-collection pipelines
